usage:
Usage: feedbai <command> [options]

Commands:
  sources                 List configured feedback sources
  fetch                   Fetch feedback items
  login matrix            Store a Matrix account (password or access token)
  login bluesky           Store a Bluesky account (app password)
  paths                   Show config, secrets and state file locations

Options:
  --project <id>          Only this project
  --source <id>           Only this source
  --since <when>          7d, 12h, 30m, an ISO date, or "last" (since previous --since last run)
  --limit <n>             Max items per source (default from config, else 50)
  --format <fmt>          md (default), json, ndjson
  --config <file>         Use this project config instead of the discovered one
  --homeserver <url>      (login matrix) Homeserver URL, default https://matrix.org
  --user <id>             (login matrix) User id, e.g. @me:matrix.org
  --token                 (login matrix) Paste an access token instead of a password
  --identifier <handle>   (login bluesky) Handle or email
  --service <url>         (login bluesky) PDS URL, default https://bsky.social
  --account <id>          (login) Account id to save as
error.noConfig: No config found. Create {project} in your repository, or {global}.
error.missingSecret: Account {account} needs the secret {name}; set it in the environment or in {file}
error.matrixForbidden: Cannot read {room}: not joined. Join it once with your account (or set "join": true on the source).
error.noSources: No sources match the given filters
prompt.appPassword: App password for {identifier} (create one at https://bsky.app/settings/app-passwords):
login.saved: Saved account "{account}" to {config} and its secret to {secrets}
